{{Short description|City in Ukhdari}}

'''Ezrum''' is a city in [[Ukhdari]] in central [[Ayuma]], with a population of approximately 1.33 million. It was one of nine cities selected as a host city for the [[1760 FLLA World Cup]].

The city's principal sporting venue is the Ezrum Coliseum, a 54,300-seat stadium that hosted six matches at the 1760 tournament, including the round-of-sixteen tie between [[Verusa]] and [[Emara]] on 1 July 1760.
